newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill details Tenneco.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill details Tenneco.

text.p: -- Merrill analyst Doug Groh confirmed he had reinstated Tenneco Inc with a near-term accumulate and long-term buy.
-- In addition, he said he had set a 12-month price objective of $58 to $59 per share and an earnings estimate for the 1997 calendar and fiscal year of $2.95 per share on the new Tenneco.
-- He said he has a preliminary estimate of about $3.35 per share for the company.
-- The stock gained 3/4 of a point to 52-1/4 in early trading.

-- The analyst said he was attracted by the company's move to split-up non-core assets and divest them and its focus "on high growth businesses that enjoy brand recognition, both in auto parts and packaging."
-- Groh said he expects the company to continue to make acquisitions and produce earnings growth at an average of 15 percent per share year over the next four to five years.
